en.askTitle: Enter your own transfer plan, old savings and later income and get the same Thai remittance-tax breakdown
en.runTitle: Bangkok: can savings from Singapore fund a condo down payment without Thai tax?

fields.label: Countries, currencies and target net cash
fields.value: From Singapore (SGD) and the US (USD) to Thailand (THB); THB 1.5 million to bring home

fields.label: Documented old earnings and remaining principal
fields.value: About SGD 60,000 in a Singapore account, saved while working there in 2019–2023, before 2024

fields.label: Later interest, gross dividends and transaction-level gains
fields.value: In 2026, about USD 900 of dividends and a gain of about USD 3,000 from selling shares in a US brokerage account worth about USD 40,000

fields.label: Income-year Thai day counts, US status and treaty conditions
fields.placeholder: e.g. 330 days in Thailand in 2026, not a US citizen or green-card holder

en.template: Help me plan a Thailand remittance for {year} using {currency}. Separate {old} from {later}. Check {status}, distinguish gross income, withholding, net cash and capped credits, and map records and the correct filing year. Explain unknowns without assuming an exemption. Planning only; do not access accounts, send money or file a return.

phases.title: Read the official rules, the treaties and the exchange rate, and list what stays uncertain
phases.note: Revenue Department instructions, Singapore and US treaty terms, and the central-bank rate
phases.judgment: It would not call a proposed tax break law. No same-year exemption could be confirmed as enacted, so the guide treats it as a reported proposal, and it says the confidence in that is moderate because the official gazette would not open.

phases.title: Run every calculation in code and write the guide and the source list
phases.note: Three scenarios: old savings only, 2026 dividends and gain, and a mix
phases.judgment: It showed how thin the margin is: SGD 60,000 converts to about THB 1,554,204 at the 6 November rate, only THB 54,204 above the THB 1.5 million target, and it labels these as planning figures, not 2027 rates.

phases.title: Independent legal and arithmetic review, then fix and re-read
phases.note: The reviewer did not write the guide
phases.judgment: The independent reviewer recomputed everything with its own calculator: 58 of 58 comparisons matched. It also reported its own slip, a fetch that fell back to a browser, and excluded that page from the evidence.

phases.title: Check desktop and phone layout and wrap up with nothing left running

workers: Searched the official sources for any later change to Thailand’s tax rule on money brought in from abroad, and whether it is law or only a proposal
Independently recomputed every money figure and checked the legal claims against the underlying texts, without having written the guide
